en.install: Install or update the Antigravity plugin in ShowAI under Settings → Agent plugins and restart the session. For a source install, make sure `agy` is available and run `npm run plugin:antigravity`.
en.features: Show interactive previews and page cards in chat. Edit originals, navigate to components and quote selections in the auxiliary pane, or browse projects in the global workbench.
en.source: To bind a development instance, run `npm run plugin:antigravity -- --port <port> --json`. Use `--remove` to uninstall that plugin.

zh.install: 在 ShowAI 的「设置 → Agent 插件」安装或更新 Antigravity 插件，重启会话。从源码安装时先确认 `agy` 可用，再运行 `npm run plugin:antigravity`。
zh.features: 聊天内显示交互预览和原页卡片。右侧辅助面板可编辑原页、定位组件并引用选区，全局工作台可浏览项目。
zh.source: 绑定开发实例时可运行 `npm run plugin:antigravity -- --port <端口> --json`，用 `--remove` 卸载该插件。
